I am a PhD researcher in computational social science at [University College Dublin](https://www.ucd.ie/spire/), funded by a Taighde Éireann – Research Ireland Government of Ireland scholarship, and based in the [Connected_Politics Lab](https://www.ucd.ie/connected_politics/) under the supervision of [James P. Cross](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Tx3mu9kAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao). My research focuses on <mark class="code code-topic" data-code="topic" tabindex="0">political communication</mark>, <mark class="code code-topic" data-code="topic" tabindex="0">climate politics</mark> and <mark class="code code-topic" data-code="topic" tabindex="0">public opinion</mark>, combining <mark class="code code-method" data-code="method" tabindex="0">text-as-data methods</mark>, <mark class="code code-method" data-code="method" tabindex="0">large language models</mark> and <mark class="code code-method" data-code="method" tabindex="0">survey experiments</mark>. I also work on best practice for LLM-based text annotation and develop <mark class="code code-software" data-code="software" tabindex="0">open-source tools</mark> for it.

Prior to my doctoral studies, I completed a BA in Computer Science, Linguistics and French at Trinity College Dublin and an MSc in Politics and Data Science at University College Dublin, complemented by two years of industry experience as a data analyst.

**I will be on the academic job market in 2027.**
